gloss: to surpass, to exceed, to be superior to

definitions.gloss: to surpass, to exceed, to be superior to
definitions.explanation: To be better than or exceed something in comparison. Used with に to mark the thing being surpassed.

examples.japanese: {質|しつ}は{量|りょう}に{勝|まさ}る。
{彼|かれ}は{体力|たいりょく}で{誰|だれ}にも{勝|まさ}る。
examples.english: He surpasses everyone in physical strength.

examples.japanese: {百聞|ひゃくもん}は{一見|いっけん}に{勝|まさ}るとも{劣|おと}らない{経験|けいけん}だった。
examples.english: It was an experience no less powerful than seeing it with one's own eyes.

notes:
Takes the pattern AはBに{勝|まさ}る (A surpasses B). Often used in written or somewhat formal contexts. The opposite is {劣|おと}る (to be inferior).

KEY PATTERNS:
・AはBに{勝|まさ}る — A surpasses B
・～に{勝|まさ}るとも{劣|おと}らない — at least as good as, no less than

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{何|なに}にも{勝|まさ}る — surpassing everything, above all else
・{言葉|ことば}に{勝|まさ}る — beyond words
・{数|かず}に{勝|まさ}る — superior in numbers

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{優|すぐ}れる — to excel, to be outstanding
・{超|こ}える — to exceed, to surpass (more general, less literary)
